class: Hot reload misses registered portal adapters
symptom: Resumed code called a new ADP adapter hook on an old adapter class and raised AttributeError.
site: Church Mutual ADP Senior Network Engineer application 548, supervised continuation 25–26 October 2026
root_cause: The reload module list hardcoded a subset of portals, omitting ADP and other registered adapters.
why_tests_missed: Reload tests checked selected helpers but not every registered portal.
fix: Derive adapter modules from sites.ADAPTERS, precompile the batch, then reload adapters before the registry and browser.
prevention: Retain portal-shaped regression fixtures, inspect every repeated record, verify committed values and preserve submission and personal-answer gates.
